flags.message: Context freezes elevated with distribution_count=2, but the June 17 distribution names September 28, 2026 and the September 16 distribution names October 9, 2026: both conferences are future as of September 17. This appears to be preconference rescheduling after a requested response, not an observed postconference relist. Retained the frozen band/count and adjusted the forecast, rather than treating two entries as two completed conferences.

The snapshot records an August 31 opposition and September 10 reply, but the provisioned document manifest contains only petition/QP text fetched July 18, with the petition marked truncated. Retrieved selected opposition pages from its exact official PDF URL; the reply and complete petition appendix were not reviewed. These limitations are reflected in reasoning.md.
